label: lem:connected_open_path_connected
title: Connected open subsets of \(\C\) are path-connected
statement:
Let \(V \subset \C\). If \(V\) is open and connected, then \(V\) is
    path-connected.
proof:
This is the standard theorem that open connected subsets of \(\mathbb{R}^n\),
    hence of \(\C\), are path-connected. In Mathlib this is essentially the
    instance \texttt{IsOpen.locPathConnectedSpace} combined with
    \texttt{IsOpen.isConnected\_iff\_isPathConnected}.
notes: Signature: `lemma isConnected_isOpen_pathConnected_complex {V : Set ℂ} (hV : IsOpen V) (hC : IsConnected V) : IsPathConnected V`. Direct application of `IsOpen.isConnected_iff_isPathConnected` (ℂ is `LocPathConnectedSpace` via its `ℝ^n` structure).
